newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia to supply telecoms network to VEW.
newsitem.headline: Nokia to supply telecoms network to VEW.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it will deliver a complete telecommunications network including switching to German regional network operator VEW Telnet GmbH.
"The delivery of the infrastructure is expected to be completed by October 1997," Nokia said.

The value of the agreement was not given, but Nokia said it called for the delivery of switching systems for fixed networks, an integrated network management system and so called Intelligent Network capacity as well as installation, commissioning, operation and maintenance.
The network will cover the cities of Dortmund, Bochum and Munster, Nokia said.
VEW Telnet is a subsidiary of German VEW Energie AG.
